# Watson Hartsoe

> Research engineer, creative technologist, and PhD candidate in Digital Media at Georgia Tech (School of Literature, Media, and Communication). He builds interfaces for worlds that don't exist yet, and the tools to find out if they should: working tools for generative media, AI filmmaking, and worldbuilding.

Recognized by the ITU AI for Good platform, Georgia Tech's AI Competition, CREATE-X, and the Neu Wave AI Film Festival. MS in Human-Computer Interaction, Georgia Tech. Fulbright fieldwork in Honduras. Method: thick prompting, a documented way of studying how a model interprets, transforms, and resists intention. Contact: watson.hartsoe@gmail.com.

## Pages

- [Home](https://hartswf0.github.io/elsewhere/): films, systems, writing, research, and a scroll cartoon about description becoming a world.
- [The Grove](https://hartswf0.github.io/elsewhere/grove.html): all 340 repositories on 11 trees by theme, searchable, sorted by ripeness (ripe, ripening, green, blossom, fallen).
- [The Orange Tree](https://hartswf0.github.io/elsewhere/orange.html): a short multiplane scroll cartoon.
- [The Shed](https://hartswf0.github.io/elsewhere/shed.html): prune and feature projects, make collections, and play small games against Watson (catch, older or newer, which tree, more work, pairs; toss is played in the grove).

## Film

- Where You Go When You Leave: feature film with poet and filmmaker Mark Anthony Thomas; the poem becomes a place (in production).
- [CINEOSIS](https://hartswf0.github.io/abc-flix/): assembly is sampling, not cutting.
- [Play, Freedom, and AI Films](https://hartswf0.github.io/elsewhere/watson-hartsoe-site/play-freedom-ai-films-tufte_5_.html)
- [The Machinery of Meaning](https://hartswf0.github.io/elsewhere/watson-hartsoe-site/machinery_of_meaning_legible_film.html): a procedural film engine you can read while it runs.

## Systems

- [Coaxing the Ripples](https://hartswf0.github.io/elsewhere/watson-hartsoe-site/ripples-conference-presentation-rebuilt.html): can a generative world remember? ELO 2026.
- [Can a Model Build with LEGO?](https://hartswf0.github.io/elsewhere/watson-hartsoe-site/can_a_language_model_build_with_lego__2_.html): model claims translated into legal LDraw parts.
- [Centaur Box](https://hartswf0.github.io/elsewhere/watson-hartsoe-site/centaur-box-presentation-concrete.html): the hidden run record beneath a persuasive conversation.
- [Gumball Emotion Machine](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Uoitq8hpcCM): an emotion classifier that returns a gumball.
